verdict.justification: The project aims to develop a system for early detection of anomalous behavior in the Windows 10 operating system to prevent ransomware attacks and data loss. The justification lies in the need for tools that can identify suspicious patterns of behavior on computer systems, specifically on Windows 10, which will enable the collection of necessary information for detecting when a ransomware attack is occurring and deploying an effective response within the operating system, significantly reducing the risk of data loss.
